# Configuration surface

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-config-surface.py — do not edit. -->

One fact can be spelled several ways. Only one of them is a place to
make a decision; the rest carry that decision across a layer boundary.
This page separates the two, because a list that does not is a list of
nine ways to set a locator (issue 0934).

74 Kconfig symbols; 31 are forwarded to the
Rust build by `zephyr/cmake/nros_cargo_build.cmake`.

## RMW backend

**Set it here:** `[system].rmw` in the bringup's `system.toml`

| carrier | default | forwarded to cargo |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CONFIG_NROS_RMW_ZENOH` | — | no |
| `CONFIG_NROS_RMW_XRCE` | — | no |
| `CONFIG_NROS_RMW_CYCLONEDDS` | — | no |

`nano_ros_workspace(BACKEND …)` and `-DNROS_RMW` are the cmake carriers. cmake already warns that BACKEND silently beats the cache var; nothing yet compares either against `[system].rmw`.

## ROS domain id

**Set it here:** `[system].domain_id` in `system.toml`

| carrier | default | forwarded to cargo |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CONFIG_NROS_DOMAIN_ID` | `0` | no |
| `CONFIG_NROS_CYCLONE_DOMAIN_ID` | `NROS_DOMAIN_ID` | no |

`CONFIG_NROS_CYCLONE_DOMAIN_ID` defaults FROM `NROS_DOMAIN_ID` — the one derivation edge in this cluster. Pinning it to a literal is the phase-180 split-brain (CLAUDE.md).

## Router / agent endpoint

**Set it here:** `[system].locator` in `system.toml`

| carrier | default | forwarded to cargo |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CONFIG_NROS_ZENOH_LOCATOR` | `tcp/127.0.0.1:7447` | no |
| `CONFIG_NROS_XRCE_AGENT_ADDR` | `127.0.0.1` | no |
| `CONFIG_NROS_XRCE_AGENT_PORT` | `2018` | no |

Zephyr is exempt from the cmake precedence chain by design (NanoRosEntry.cmake:485), so the Kconfig spelling is the carrier there rather than an override.

## Executor sizing

**Set it here:** environment knobs at build time (see the pool inventory)

| carrier | default | forwarded to cargo |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CONFIG_NROS_EXECUTOR_MAX_CBS` | `4` | yes |
| `CONFIG_NROS_EXECUTOR_MAX_SC` | `8` | yes |
| `CONFIG_NROS_EXECUTOR_MAX_NODES` | `4` | yes |
| `CONFIG_NROS_EXECUTOR_ARENA_SIZE` | `0` | yes |
| `CONFIG_NROS_EXECUTOR_MAX_SHUTDOWN_CBS` | `2` | yes |
| `CONFIG_NROS_EXECUTOR_ACTION_CLIENTS` | `4` | yes |
| `CONFIG_NROS_SUBSCRIPTION_BUFFER_SIZE` | `1024` | yes |
| `CONFIG_NROS_PARAM_SERVICE_BUFFER_SIZE` | `4096` | yes |
| `CONFIG_NROS_MAX_PARAMETERS` | `32` | yes |

On Zephyr the Kconfig spelling IS how a user sets these — it is a carrier only in the sense that the env var is what the build script reads. Issue 0460 is what happens when the bridge breaks.

## Dead

Declared, and read by nothing. Delete or wire — a knob that is
documented and inert is worse than one that is absent.

| symbol | why |
| --- | --- |
| `CONFIG_NROS_INIT_DELAY_MS` | zero source readers; two guides still document it as live |
| `CONFIG_NROS_TRANSPORT_SERIAL` | zero references anywhere in the tree |
